1. System Architecture & Core Philosophy

Core Principle: Intelligence Sales is not an AI novelty chatbot. It is a high-velocity B2B Commercial Operating System engineered to drive real wholesale and enterprise product trade. The 7 AI Agents function as autonomous force multipliers embedded inside human sales workflows—handling lead scoring, margin protection, follow-up automation, and contract generation while keeping humans in the loop for final commitment.

1.1 Core Domain Entities & Relational Hierarchy

The database layer consists of 7 tightly interconnected relational entities mapped inside Laravel 11 with SQLite/MySQL:

Entity Database Table Key Attributes Role in Workflow
Account accounts name, industry, city, phone, email, status, tier, ICE, IF, Patente, credit_limit Enterprise client company profile. The parent root for all deals, quotes, and contacts.
User users name, email, role, account_id, title, phone, quota System actor. Roles: admin, manager, rep, or client.
Lead leads name, company, email, phone, source, status, ai_score, score_reason, user_id, account_id Inbound prospect. Evaluated from 0-100 by the Lead Intelligence Agent before conversion.
Deal deals title, account_id, user_id, amount, stage, probability, expected_close_date Active revenue opportunity in the 6-stage sales pipeline. Owned by a sales rep.
Quote quotes quote_number, deal_id, account_id, discount_percent, discount_approved, public_token Commercial offer with itemized line items, discount governance, and legal E-signature token.
Activity activities user_id, deal_id, lead_id, account_id, type, title, description, completed, idempotency_key Unified audit and follow-up timeline tracking every call, email, meeting, and stage shift.

1.2 Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & Data Isolation

Data scoping is strictly enforced at the database query level via App\Support\CrmAccess:

  • Admin & Sales Director: Full visibility across all reps, all deals, company-wide revenue forecasts, user management, and system configuration.
  • Sales Manager: Can reassign deals among commercial representatives, supervise team quotas, and holds exclusive authority to approve quotes with discounts exceeding 15%.
  • Commercial Sales Representative (Rep): Restricted strictly to deals, quotes, and accounts in their assigned portfolio, plus unassigned inbound leads. Reps cannot reassign deals to other users.
  • B2B Client: Restricted strictly to their own enterprise account records (account_id). Can only view proposals addressed to their enterprise and sign quotes.
Figure 1: Authentication Portal with multi-role RBAC access switcher (Admin, Manager, Rep, Client). URL: /login

2. Perspective 1: Executive & Sales Management (Admin / Manager)

For the CRO, VP of Sales, and Regional Sales Managers, Intelligence Sales provides a centralized mission-control cockpit designed to govern revenue, eliminate deal slippage, inspect rep behaviors, and enforce commercial margin rules.

Figure 2: Executive Dashboard — Real-time revenue forecasting, stage conversion funnel, and team quota pacing. URL: /crm/dashboard

2.1 Revenue Forecasting & Quota Pacing

The dashboard synthesizes closed-won ARR/MRR against annual commercial targets. Revenue projections are weighted automatically by stage probabilities (Leads 10%, Qualification 30%, Discovery 50%, Proposal 70%, Negotiation 80%, Won 100%).

Figure 3: Deals Pipeline Kanban — Multi-stage visual progression with deal values, probabilities, and stage locks. URL: /crm/pipeline

2.2 Deal Assignment & Rep Workload Reallocation

Managers can inspect any opportunity card and reassign it to another sales representative via the Deal Inspection Modal. The backend checks caller role via CrmAccess::isManager(), preventing unauthorized reps from altering deal ownership while empowering managers to balance team workloads.

Figure 4: Deal Detail Modal — AI next-step recommendations, product bundles, and Manager-only Rep Selector. Component: CrmPipeline.jsx

2. Perspective 1 (Cont.): Governance, Auditability & Margin Protection

2.3 Rep Activity Logs & Audit Trail (/crm/rep-logs)

A dedicated audit navigation item (/crm/rep-logs) gives managers complete step-by-step transparency into every action performed by sales representatives: stage advancements, inbound lead conversions, quotation dispatches, and client communications. Each log records the exact rep ID, timestamp, target account, and operational payload.

Figure 5: Rep Activity Logs — Audit trail showing real-time timestamps, deal progression, and rep actions. URL: /crm/rep-logs

2.4 Margin Protection & The 15% Discount Approval Rule

Sales reps frequently encounter price pushback. However, unconstrained discounting degrades enterprise profit margins. The platform enforces an ironclad governance threshold:

  • Discounts ≤ 15%: Commercial reps can approve and dispatch directly to the client.
  • Discounts > 15%: The quotation status locks automatically into Pending Approval. The dispatch button and public signing token are disabled until a Sales Manager or Director clicks Approve Discount. Any direct attempt to bypass this via API yields a 403 Forbidden error.
Figure 6: Quotations Directory — Enforcing margin rules, discount approvals, and secret public token links. URL: /crm/quotes

3. Perspective 2: Commercial Sales Representative (Rep) Workstation

For the sales executive in the field, Intelligence Sales acts as an intelligent co-pilot. Reps start their day by reviewing assigned inbound leads, checking AI qualification scores, advancing pipeline opportunities, and drafting itemized product quotes.

3.1 Inbound Lead Claiming & AI Qualification Scoring (/crm/leads)

When an inbound proposal request arrives from the website, it enters the rep queue marked with a pulsating NEW badge on the card corner. The Lead Intelligence Agent scores the prospect from 0 to 100 based on estimated order volume, corporate domain credibility, and stated requirements.

Figure 7: Leads Directory — Pulsating Red "NEW" corner badge, 0-100 AI Score, and 1-Click Convert button. URL: /crm/leads

3.2 1-Click Conversion: Lead → Enterprise Account + Opportunity

Clicking Convert to Opportunity executes an atomic transaction in MySQL: creates an active Enterprise Account, provisions a Deal in the Qualification stage, links the contact, and archives the lead.

Figure 8: New Lead Modal — Capturing contact info with searchable international dial code and country flag. Component: PhoneInputField.jsx

3.3 Smart Follow-Up & The 7-Day Inactivity Rule (/crm/activities)

Deals with no interaction for 7 days are automatically flagged. The Follow-Up Agent drafts personalized re-engagement messages in French, Arabic, and English for one-click rep review before transmission.

Figure 9: Activities Timeline — 7-day dormancy warnings, scheduled calls, and automated follow-up drafts. URL: /crm/activities

4. Perspective 3: B2B Client Experience & Journey

The B2B client experience is frictionless, transparent, and professional—from initial proposal submission on the landing page to portal access and legal digital contract signing.

Figure 10: Landing Page Hero — Highlighting wholesale product distribution and Request Proposal CTA. URL: /

4.1 Seamless Inbound Quotation Request & Automated Account Creation

When a prospect clicks Demande de Devis, they enter their enterprise details and phone number using the international flag selector. Upon submission:

  1. An Enterprise Account is automatically created in the database.
  2. A Client User portal account is created with a generated temporary password (e.g. Client@9750).
  3. A branded Welcome Email is dispatched to the submitted inbox with quotation reference (DEV-2026-XXXX), credentials, and portal link.
  4. The credentials card appears immediately on screen with a 1-click Copy Credentials button and direct Go to Portal link.
Figure 11: Quotation Request Modal — Phone input starting with +dial code and national flag emoji. Component: PartnerModal.jsx

4. Perspective 3 (Cont.): Client Space & Legal E-Signature Portal

4.2 The Dedicated B2B Client Space (/crm/dashboard as Client)

When clients log in, their navigation is strictly scoped to client-facing features: Mon Espace Client, Mes Devis & Offres, and Historique & Jalons. They can inspect proposals addressed to their enterprise and contact their assigned commercial executive directly.

Figure 12: B2B Client Space — Viewing approved commercial limits, active proposals, and rep contact card. URL: /crm/dashboard (Client Role)

4.3 Public Quotation Review & Legal E-Signature (/portal/quote/:token)

Clients access their itemized quotation through a secure secret URL. The portal displays full commercial transparency: item descriptions, unit prices, volume discounts, and 20% legal Moroccan VAT (TVA).

Clients can sign electronically by providing their Signer Name, optional Purchase Order (PO) number, special instructions, and agreeing to the formal commercial terms. Signing automatically moves the CRM Deal to Closed Won.

Figure 13: Public Quotation Portal — Itemized bill of materials, VAT calculation, and E-Signature form. URL: /portal/quote/:token

AI Agent #1: Lead Intelligence & Scoring Agent
Code ID: lead_intelligence

Mission: Instantly evaluates incoming commercial proposals, predicts conversion probability (0-100), tags temperature, and synthesizes an executive qualification rationale.

UI Visual Anchor
Figure 7: Leads Directory (/crm/leads)
Trigger Hook
Event: POST /api/public/proposals & Lead::created
Recommended ML Engine
LightGBM Classifier + Claude 3.5 Sonnet / Gemini 1.5 Flash
Target Latency SLA
< 1,200 ms (Asynchronous Event Listener)
Input JSON Payload (From Laravel):
{
  "lead_id": 14,
  "company_name": "Atlas Agro SARL",
  "contact_name": "Sara Chraibi",
  "email": "sara@atlasagro.ma",
  "phone": "+212 661 99 88 77",
  "city": "Meknès",
  "estimated_volume": "200 000 – 500 000 MAD",
  "product_category": "Fresh Agri-Products Wholesale",
  "notes": "Urgent quote request for 500 tons seasonal supply."
}
Expected AI Output Schema (To be returned as pure JSON):
{
  "ai_score": 92,
  "temperature": "Hot",
  "score_reason": "High-volume wholesale demand with verified corporate domain (.ma). Immediate purchasing timeframe in agricultural hub.",
  "risk_factors": ["Seasonal shelf-life sensitivity", "High initial credit exposure"],
  "recommended_rep_skills": ["Commodity Agri-Trade", "Fast Fulfillment Logistics"]
}

Database Mutation: Updates leads.ai_score = 92 and leads.score_reason = score_reason.

AI Agent #7: Autonomous Sales Workflow & Trigger Agent
Code ID: automation_agent

Mission: Event-driven sales workflow execution. When an external trigger occurs (e.g. client signs quote online, proposal submitted), automatically executes downstream state mutations: wins the deal, provisions accounts, dispatches logistics orders, and sends alerts.

UI Visual Anchor
Figure 13: Quote Signing Portal (/portal/quote/:token)
Trigger Hook
Event: POST /api/public/quotes/:token/accept
Idempotency Key
Required (Prevents double stage progression)
Downstream Sync
Intelligence Logistique & ERP Sales Order Generation
Execution Flow Blueprint:
1. Client submits digital signature on /portal/quote/:token
2. automation_agent intercepts event:
   a) Sets quote.status = 'Accepted', logs signer_name & po_number
   b) Sets deal.stage = 'won', probability = 100%
   c) Creates Activity log entry for rep & manager
   d) Dispatches confirmation email to client with counter-signed PDF
   e) Emits webhook to ERP / Logistics API for order fulfillment
